name: sevolve-seed
description: Seed eval set: concise-summary skill. Enough real task-shaped examples to cold-start the loop and prove a known-good artifact beats a known-bad one.

tasks.task:
Summarize the following text in at most 40 words, keeping the main point and the exact date:
"The RBI announced on 2026-07-15 that repo rates would be cut by 25 basis points effective immediately, citing cooling inflation and a need to support credit growth. Analysts called the move a surprise and flagged possible effects on deposit rates."

Summarize the following text in at most 40 words, keeping the main point and the exact number:
"The 2026 State of the Cloud report found that 64% of enterprises now run more than half their workloads in public cloud, up from 51% the previous year, with cost optimization overtaking migration as the top initiative."
